mapper.sql: REVIEW_NUM, USER_NUM, REVIEW_TITLE, REVIEW_STATUS, REVIEW_MODE, CUSTOM_CRITERIA, INSTRUCTIONS, MODEL_NAME, PROMPT_VERSION, RESPONSE_VERSION, CREATED_AT, FINISHED_AT
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_T_DOCUMENT_REVIEW.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO T_DOCUMENT_REVIEW (REVIEW_NUM, USER_NUM, REVIEW_TITLE, REVIEW_STATUS, REVIEW_MODE, CUSTOM_CRITERIA, INSTRUCTIONS, MODEL_NAME, PROMPT_VERSION, RESPONSE_VERSION) VALUES (#{reviewNum}, #{userNum}, #{reviewTitle}, 'PROCESSING', #{reviewMode}, #{customCriteria,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{instructions,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{modelName}, #{promptVersion}, #{responseVersion})

SELECT SEQ_T_REVIEW_DOCUMENT.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO T_REVIEW_DOCUMENT (REVIEW_DOCUMENT_NUM, REVIEW_NUM, DOCUMENT_TYPE, SOURCE_DOCUMENT_NUM, DOCUMENT_TITLE, SOURCE_UPDATED_AT, SOURCE_SNAPSHOT_JSON, ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME, PDF_SNAPSHOT, DOCUMENT_SUMMARY) VALUES (#{reviewDocumentNum}, #{reviewNum}, #{documentType}, #{sourceDocumentNum}, #{documentTitle}, #{sourceUpdatedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{sourceSnapshotJson,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{originalFileName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{pdfSnapshot,jdbcType=BLOB}, #{summary,jdbcType=CLOB})

INSERT INTO T_REVIEW_STRENGTH (REVIEW_NUM, REVIEW_DOCUMENT_NUM, DISPLAY_ORDER, STRENGTH_CONTENT) VALUES (#{reviewNum}, #{reviewDocumentNum,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{displayOrder}, #{content,jdbcType=CLOB})

INSERT INTO T_REVIEW_IMPROVEMENT (REVIEW_DOCUMENT_NUM, DISPLAY_ORDER, SECTION_NAME, IMPROVEMENT_TITLE, ISSUE_CONTENT, ORIGINAL_CONTENT, SUGGESTED_CONTENT, REASON_CONTENT) VALUES (#{reviewDocumentNum}, #{displayOrder}, #{section}, #{title}, #{issue,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{original,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{suggestion,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{reason,jdbcType=CLOB})

SELECT SEQ_T_REVIEW_CONSISTENCY.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO T_REVIEW_CONSISTENCY (CONSISTENCY_NUM, REVIEW_NUM, DISPLAY_ORDER, ISSUE_TYPE, ISSUE_TITLE, RECOMMENDATION) VALUES (#{consistencyNum}, #{reviewNum}, #{displayOrder}, #{type}, #{title}, #{recommendation,jdbcType=CLOB})

INSERT INTO T_REVIEW_SOURCE (CONSISTENCY_NUM, DISPLAY_ORDER, REVIEW_NUM, REVIEW_DOCUMENT_NUM, SECTION_NAME, SOURCE_CONTENT, PAGE_NUMBER) VALUES (#{consistencyNum}, #{displayOrder}, #{reviewNum}, #{reviewDocumentNum}, #{section}, #{text,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{pageNumber,jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.update: UPDATE T_DOCUMENT_REVIEW SET OVERALL_SUMMARY = #{summary,jdbcType=CLOB}, REVIEW_STATUS = 'COMPLETED', FINISHED_AT = LOCALTIMESTAMP WHERE REVIEW_NUM = #{reviewNum} AND USER_NUM = #{userNum} AND REVIEW_STATUS = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.select: SELECT , OVERALL_SUMMARY AS SUMMARY FROM T_DOCUMENT_REVIEW WHERE REVIEW_NUM = #{reviewNum} AND USER_NUM = #{userNum}
SELECT FROM T_DOCUMENT_REVIEW WHERE USER_NUM = #{userNum} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, REVIEW_NUM DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY

SELECT REVIEW_DOCUMENT_NUM, REVIEW_NUM, DOCUMENT_TYPE, SOURCE_DOCUMENT_NUM, DOCUMENT_TITLE, SOURCE_UPDATED_AT, ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME, DOCUMENT_SUMMARY AS SUMMARY FROM T_REVIEW_DOCUMENT WHERE REVIEW_NUM = #{reviewNum} ORDER BY CASE DOCUMENT_TYPE WHEN 'resume' THEN 1 WHEN 'cover-letter' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

SELECT I.REVIEW_DOCUMENT_NUM, I.DISPLAY_ORDER, I.SECTION_NAME AS SECTION, I.IMPROVEMENT_TITLE AS TITLE, I.ISSUE_CONTENT AS ISSUE, I.ORIGINAL_CONTENT AS ORIGINAL, I.SUGGESTED_CONTENT AS SUGGESTION, I.REASON_CONTENT AS REASON FROM T_REVIEW_IMPROVEMENT I JOIN T_REVIEW_DOCUMENT D ON D.REVIEW_DOCUMENT_NUM = I.REVIEW_DOCUMENT_NUM WHERE D.REVIEW_NUM = #{reviewNum} ORDER BY I.REVIEW_DOCUMENT_NUM, I.DISPLAY_ORDER
SELECT CONSISTENCY_NUM, REVIEW_NUM, DISPLAY_ORDER, ISSUE_TYPE AS TYPE, ISSUE_TITLE AS TITLE, RECOMMENDATION FROM T_REVIEW_CONSISTENCY WHERE REVIEW_NUM = #{reviewNum} ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER

SELECT S.CONSISTENCY_NUM, S.REVIEW_NUM, S.REVIEW_DOCUMENT_NUM, S.DISPLAY_ORDER, D.DOCUMENT_TYPE, S.SECTION_NAME AS SECTION, S.SOURCE_CONTENT AS TEXT, S.PAGE_NUMBER FROM T_REVIEW_SOURCE S JOIN T_REVIEW_DOCUMENT D ON D.REVIEW_DOCUMENT_NUM = S.REVIEW_DOCUMENT_NUM AND D.REVIEW_NUM = S.REVIEW_NUM WHERE S.REVIEW_NUM = #{reviewNum} ORDER BY S.CONSISTENCY_NUM, S.DISPLAY_ORDER
